summary: Controls whether Claude may or must call a tool. Lixpi owns it because tool requirements come from the orchestration graph; model settings must not override routing. When thinking compatibility requires automatic selection, the request omits forced any/tool choices.
combines: Supported on: all models, with a manual-thinking restriction

With manual extended thinking (`thinking: {type: "enabled"}`) only `auto` and `none` are allowed. `any` and `{"type": "tool", ...}` force tool use, which is incompatible with manual extended thinking, and error.
Adaptive thinking, including on models where thinking is on by default, supports forced tool use.
note: Pipeline-owned. Forced choices are omitted whenever the model's thinking profile requires automatic tool selection.
